title: 49 CFR 171-180 - Hazardous Materials Regulations (DOT/PHMSA)
description: The third regulator. OSHA governs a chemical in the workplace, EPA released or disposed, DOT in transit. Hazmat questions surface in all three contexts, which is why this is standalone and recommended by both meta-packs rather than a member of either - a member of both would double-install and misattribute the publisher. Part 172 holds the Hazardous Materials Table and the hazmat-employee training rules that overlap OSHA HazCom training.
